ruling_text:
The motion of defendant Xian Li for an order requiring plaintiff Jun Li
to furnish security under Corp. Code § 17709.02 is OFF CALENDAR
for improper electronic service on the self-represented plaintiff.
The motion of plaintiff Rafael Arroyo for a terminating sanction that
strikes the answer of defendants 888Bottles LLC, Super 8, Inc., and
888Infinity LLC, and enters the defaults of these defendants is
GRANTED to the extent that it asks for an order striking the answer
of the defendants. Plaintiff can then seek default against the
defendants as well as default judgment.
